VERDICT: REJECT

The proposed classification ("rt = 1 for n ≤ 8, rt = 2 for n ≥ 9" for generic points) does not match any result I can confidently recall. The relation type of generic points in $\mathbb{P}^2$ depends on the Hilbert function and syzygies of the ideal, which change in a more intricate way than a single threshold at 9. The solution also gives no derivation or citation, so nothing supports the stated thresholds. I cannot verify the value 11 → 2 from first principles here, and I do not believe it is established. I suspect the correct value is different, possibly 3, but I am not certain of that.

CONFIDENCE: 2
